Added oversized molten-neon eyes (with PointLights) + 3 neon torso cracks for enemy readability
Framed one capture to confirm shaped, above-blob silhouette
make_npc damage=45 speed=5 detect=24 attackRange=7 cooldown=2.5
Verified attributes, collidable HRP, AI script, state=idle

recipe.text: Fresh concept: a Stone Golem brute distinct from prior husk/skeleton enemies. Standard R15 rig recolored to pale granite (Slate) with dark stone limbs, oversized molten-orange neon eyes + torso cracks so it reads as a heavy stone enemy at gameplay distance. make_npc configures a slow (WalkSpeed 5), high-damage (45), short-detect (24) brute that attacks every 2.5s within 7 studs. Collidable HRP + standard leg HipHeight so it walks the floor cleanly.
